description: v1 golden set of real, human-curated CME frames sourced from the Osborn 2021-03-09 case (0.5s sampling). Labels follow the production analyzer vocabulary in backend/lambda_functions/prompts/production.py. See docs/golden_set_curation.md for the curation rationale and limitations.

clips.notes: Intake/history-taking moment with both parties seated and the doctor facing the patient. Positive engagement baseline.

expected.notes: Doctor and patient seated face-to-face during the interview portion of the exam; clear eye contact and engaged posture.

clips.notes: Doctor seated at desk with back partially turned, writing on paperwork rather than engaging the patient during what is still the conversation phase.

expected.notes: Doctor turned toward the desk taking notes; not facing the patient and not making eye contact. Exercises the inattention behavior signal without phone distraction.

clips.notes: Doctor holding phone to ear while patient sits waiting; classic distraction red flag.

expected.notes: Doctor on phone during examination time while patient waits seated; exercises the doctor_on_phone_or_distracted signal.

clips.notes: Patient covering face / wiping eyes consistent with emotional distress while doctor continues writing notes. Two consecutive frames confirm the distress is sustained, not a momentary expression.

expected.notes: Patient is visibly emotionally distressed (hand to face / wiping eyes) across consecutive frames; doctor is turned to paperwork rather than acknowledging the distress.

clips.notes: Active manual muscle/strength testing on the arm while patient remains in street clothes. Exercises both test_type=strength and the testing_through_clothing technique flag.

expected.notes: Manual muscle/resistance testing of the arm with patient in street clothes; the testing-through-clothing flag is the legally relevant red flag.

clips.notes: Range-of-motion assessment of the leg with no measurement device visible. This is the no_goniometer red flag that directly contradicts the report's claim of objective ROM measurement. Two consecutive frames confirm the equipment is absent across the test, not just a single sampling.

expected.notes: ROM testing of the leg without a goniometer or other measurement device. The legal red flag here is no_goniometer, which the v1 analyzer correctly flagged on the adjacent frame and which we accept after manual re-review.

clips.notes: Hallway gait assessment with doctor walking alongside the patient; both visible, but patient is in street clothes rather than gown.

expected.notes: Gait test conducted in a hallway with patient in street clothes; exercises test_type=gait and the patient_not_in_gown attire flag.

clips.notes: Two-handed palpation of the neck while patient remains in street clothes.

expected.notes: Bilateral neck palpation with patient still in street clothes; doctor's gaze is on the exam site rather than on the patient's face.

clips.notes: Sensory testing performed over the sleeve of a black cardigan rather than on bare skin. Patient is partially gowned for the upper body but the sleeve still blocks the tested area.

expected.notes: Sensory exam performed over a cardigan sleeve; the testing_through_clothing flag fires even though the patient is otherwise partially gowned.

clips.notes: Empty hallway / transition shot with no doctor or patient visible. Exercises the obscured-visibility code path so the eval cannot get away with hallucinating exam content.

expected.notes: No exam visible: empty hallway / setup shot. Categorical attire and behavior fields are intentionally omitted because neither party is in frame.
